title: Gloria (Palestrina, Missa Benedicta es)
desc: Giovanni Pierluigi da Palestrina, Missa Benedicta es, Gloria, 1565. 6 voices (Discantus, Contratenor 1, Contratenor 2, Tenor, Bassus 1, Bassus 2), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
